description: This PHP class defines database migration tasks for creating and dropping tables related to 'call to action' features, including methods for retrieving SQL statements for migration up and down.

classes.name: GoteoCallToAction
classes.description: A class encapsulating migration logic for creating and dropping 'call to action' related database tables.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to create 'call_to_action' and 'call_to_action_lang' tables.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to drop the aforementioned tables.
